summary.intent: Fix CI failures across nine open PRs caused by the ubuntu-26.04 runner image, establish a trail-first workflow with Entire, then clean up trails, report project status, and rewrite poorly written changesets so the 0.17.0 changelog is user-friendly.
summary.outcome: CI fixed and all nine PRs (#410-#418) merged via the ubuntu-26.04 test fix (#419); trails #136-#138 closed and link-first workflow settled. Changesets were rewritten into one-topic files on a new branch and committed signed, but not yet pushed or opened as a PR.

repo: ubuntu-26.04 runner image broke a test that symlinked /usr/bin/env as a stand-in `cargo` (multi-call env); replacing the symlink with a two-line script fixed Test Suite and Coverage jobs.
Repo has delete_branch_on_merge enabled, so merged head branches vanish and `entire trail link` fails with 'Change branch does not exist' afterward.
A `gh` shim on this machine opens orin-dx PRs as `orin-dx-pr-bot` so a human can approve them, and fails closed.
Entire trails: a branch belongs to only one trail; CLI has only `link` and `unlink`, no reparent. Entire auto-creates a trail per PR opened outside the link-first flow.
Linking a branch to a trail makes Entire open its own backing PR (marked `entire-shadow-pr`, titled with the branch name, authored as the user); a later `gh pr create` just prints that PR's URL.
Entire Gates check fails until a reviewer approves the trail; it's an approval gate, not CI.
AGENTS.md requires one changeset per user-visible topic; changesets that begin with a bullet render as `- - ...` in the changelog and fuse entries.
Release PR #409 gets no CI because the workflow token pushes the branch; latest release is 0.16.0 with everything since unreleased.
workflow: Read `gh pr create` output in full; truncating to the last line led to mistaking an existing PR URL for success.
Brief sub-agents with AGENTS.md changelog rules, and review their generated changesets before committing.
Plan trails and assign branches first, then push, link with `--base main`, and edit the Entire-opened PR instead of running `gh pr create`.
Cherry-picking one fix commit onto many PR branches with plain pushes avoided force-pushes and merged cleanly where branches overlapped.
Verify live state (open PRs, issues, releases) before reporting status rather than relying on an older plan file.

friction: Misread `gh pr create` output and wrongly told the user no auto-trail had appeared and that #419 was my PR; had to correct the memory note twice.
No CLI or API way to move an existing PR's branch between trails, so the nine PRs stayed on auto-trails and the three feature trails ended up with no PRs.
Branch auto-deletion on merge blocked post-merge linking, so the three #137 branches had to be restored by hand.
Sub-agent-written changesets shipped with broken rendering, bundled topics, vague lead-ins and internal jargon.
open_items: Push the changeset-rewrite branch, open its PR via the link-first flow, and merge it before release PR #409 so the 0.17.0 changelog is clean.
Merge #409 and watch it as the live test of the duplicate-run fix and `release pending` selection.
Fix the release PR getting no CI because of the workflow-token push.
Trail #151 is still open; its done criteria are met and it can be closed.
Trail #136's 'next release runs clean' item is unverified, and the PyPI digest question is recorded nowhere else.
Pending decisions: whether PyPI uploads must carry an index digest, whether `status` shows plan diagnostics that `--strict` can't escalate, PAT or deploy key support for E180, and accepting ADR 12.
About 15 spec clauses still have no tests; terminal/pipe behavior and action credential scoping are unverified.
Cosmetic: `--package cargo:app` with no severity reports E271 instead of E316, and the renamed-package case misses the `previous-tag-templates` diagnostic.

Pre-1.0 feature gaps: private and HTML-only PyPI indexes, npm channel promotion, checksums and wrapper bump severity, workspace-root package.json as a package, and fixed-group shared tag/title (E194).
Decide whether to disable delete_branch_on_merge so post-merge trail linking works.
